name: hud_ui_cycle_selector_widget_destructor_core
description: HudUiCycleSelectorWidget::~HudUiCycleSelectorWidget deletes all paired child-entry slots through scalar-deleting destructor dispatch, clears those slots, and chains to HudUiZrdWidget destruction.
known_limits: The native smoke covers the owner destructor path; direct child scalar-deleting dispatch and derived-table restoration are covered by the accepted VC5 byte comparison.
functional_evidence: Native smoke zhud_options_dialog_destructor_core_smoke constructs an isolated options dialog and drives the recovered owner destructor path, which destroys the resolution, sound-quality, effects, texture-memory, and object-detail HudUiCycleSelectorWidget members through their DestructorCore cleanup and verifies the option-panel child widgets reach common widget ftable state.
Current Binary Ninja disassembly for 0x4b7de0 shows 20 iterations over paired entriesA/entriesB slots with indirect virtual destructor-slot calls and a final HudUiZrdWidget destructor call.
Current Binary Ninja disassembly for 0x40cf40 tail-jumps to HudUiCycleSelectorWidget::DestructorCore; 0x41a570 calls that thunk, optionally deletes self when flags bit 0 is set, and returns self.
